- `{print a; p=1; a=""}`: Print the contents of the `a` variable, set the `p` variable to 1 (indicating that we're now in an empty line), and reset the `a` variable to an empty string.
- `END{print a}`: At the end of the file, print any remaining contents of the `a` variable (in case the last line of the file is not empty).
